OpenClaw 2026.11.3

Highlights

  • Private task results: Keep private subagent completions out of streamed chat replies. (#188490) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Reliable child-task handoffs: Allow a parent to hand off to replacement work after cancelling a child, without leaving the cancelled child's completion receipt blocking the handoff. (#178893; related #178565) Thanks @brianmcguire and @letsc4.
  • Visible tool failures: Report unanswered tool failures instead of silently ending a user-addressed turn as a success. (#182458; related #99645) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @rdleclerc.
  • Bounded authentication: Stop stalled provider authentication at the run deadline and propagate cancellation through authentication work. (#189144) Thanks @amittell.
  • Sandboxed image access: Keep required-sandbox image previews inside allowed folders, even in Full Access mode, while preserving explicit administrator image allowances. (#176203) Thanks @shakkernerd.
  • Verified workspace connections: Preserve saved node certificate pins when an empty fingerprint is supplied, and verify workspace-transfer certificates before sending credentials or data. (#125646, #190002) Thanks @wanyongstar and @avelev99.
  • Faster, responsive Gateway: Reduce startup module-file loading overhead and avoid stalls when abort-command detection encounters long punctuation runs. (#192217, #184433) Thanks @karkarl, @RomneyDa, @LeizhenZhang, and @obviyus.

Changes

No new configuration options or features.

Fixes

  • Credential isolation: Keep reused and cached plugin results scoped to their connection credentials, and keep other plugins' transport hooks on the provider's origin. (#178444, #177974, #189423) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
  • Search and memory credentials: Keep Firecrawl search and scrape keys with their scoped endpoints and embedding credentials with their destination. (#190706, #184966) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt and @eleqtrizit.
  • Credential redaction: Redact inline environment credentials from configuration reads and reflected search credentials from Exa errors. (#190618, #178745) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @yetval.
  • Child-process environments: Prevent managed Signal daemons and bundled language servers from inheriting unrelated Gateway secrets. (#179198, #179415) Thanks @VACInc.
  • Authentication errors: Surface credential-read failures rather than treating them as missing credentials, and reject explicitly selected auth profiles belonging to incompatible providers. (#173970, #181597) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Channel safety: Keep incoming Twitch IRC content out of parser error logs and require explicit request IDs when multiple Tlon approvals are pending. (#174552, #186243) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @mmaps.
  • Scheduled jobs: Handle queued cron storage failures without exiting the Gateway, and clear one-shot cleanup when a job becomes recurring. (#175678, #168985) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @yxshee, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
  • Updates: Let profile-backed updates recognize their own maintenance lock and preserve cancellation when ledger writes are deferred. (#177792, #187998) Thanks @GrahamMcBain and @vincentkoc.
  • Update recovery: Recover safely when the initial package-presence check times out, requiring a fresh valid directory identity before replacement and retaining rollback to the original package. (#181906) Authored by @steipete.
  • Anthropic usage caps: Recognize exhausted plural usage-limit errors without spending the transient rate-limit retry budget. (#176186; related #176179) Thanks @sunlit-deng and @blue-dot-1.
  • Terminal sessions: Forward /reset soft to the Gateway instead of hard-resetting the session. (#172431) Thanks @yetval and @obviyus.
  • Git recovery: Preserve uncertain command failures during Git repair rather than treating an unconfirmed operation as successful. (#176006) Authored by @steipete.
  • Memory provider selection: Accept mixed-case none and auto provider values. (#186310) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @sagealice2002-dotcom.

OpenClaw 2026.11.2

Highlights

  • Privacy and trust boundaries: Keep configuration secrets, conversation content, tool errors, and channel payloads out of diagnostic logs, enforce the selected provider and navigation trust boundaries, and release MCP grants after warm CLI turns. (#191318) (#174998) (#174544) (#172963) (#174526) (#173422) (#191748) (#191271) (#193438) (#191102) (#191980) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @wangmiao0668000666, @Finn763, @pgondhi987, @SebTardif, and @vincentkoc.
  • Account-safe delivery: Preserve sender and account identity across durable retries and scheduled delivery, recover WhatsApp identity lookup, and retain Teams routing and allowlist settings across reloads. (#191819) (#193052) (#187637) (#186709) (#186334) Thanks @vincentkoc, @YangManBOBO, @yousan, and @nxmxbbd.
  • Gateway availability: Reduce diagnostic capture work and avoid blocking the Gateway on plugin cleanup or pathological Telegram tables; cancel channel startup during shutdown and recover transient schema-lease conflicts. (#186666) (#180957) (#191675) (#183217) (#193452) (#191882) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @651juan, @amittell, @hannesrudolph, @zhangguiping-xydt, @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
  • Safer recovery and updates: Preserve configured plugin executables and environment references through updates, repair macOS service recovery when Trash access is denied, and avoid update self-fencing and interrupted-update hangs. (#191693) (#193074) (#189321) (#193431) (#193263) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @sukhdeepjohar.
  • Native client recovery: Keep iOS reconnect navigation responsive, preserve Android chat startup state, and recover Apple model and computer-use resources after transient initialization failures. (#191560) (#177347) (#191965) (#192001) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @TameTheGame, and @vincentkoc.
  • Installation and state correctness: Restore browser-extension installation with Ubuntu’s default permissions, handle Windows state-directory casing, and preserve database ownership when reserving worktree capacity or recording authentication failures. (#186782) (#185917) (#192537) (#189901) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @javiermv, @YangManBOBO, @galiniliev, and @etzelm.

Changes

  • Optional diagnostic content capture now bounds attribute and candidate payload sizes and omits oversized image data, reducing diagnostic payload fidelity to protect Gateway responsiveness; this does not limit prompts or conversation history.

Fixes

  • Model routing and providers: Respect disabled reasoning, tier-suffixed settings, aliases, catalog readiness, quota reset periods, and provider request context; retain OpenCode Go models during endpoint outages. (#174156) (#170589) (#177340) (#176471) (#175898) (#172231) (#172711) (#193234) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @EmeraldPi, @huyengiang101086-spec, @abacha, @galiniliev, @fhgffy, @1052326311, and @theimmortal68.
  • Codex and Claude integrations: Preserve imported sign-ins, refresh inherited workspace edits, keep native threads across proxy restarts, avoid unnecessary startup refreshes, and preserve permission mode and login-marker boundaries. (#178268) (#191439) (#177110) (#172727) (#177677) (#178193) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @potoior, @mnowrot, @Oldrich333, @Kimiyu-186, @sunlit-deng, and @eliavb43.
  • Memory and embeddings: Bound assembled recall context, accept the memory-search limit alias, and forward the Azure OpenAI embedding API version correctly. (#110898) (#172630) (#139436) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joeykrug, @wr-web, @beebee, @LiuwqGit, @obviyus, and @OliPlus.
  • Worker and database lifecycle: Keep unavailable environments out of admission budgets, resume reconciliation after database seals, preserve environments during Doctor checks, reject quarantined cached reads, and detect held database aliases before maintenance. (#174735) (#175185) (#156160) (#173671) (#155759) (#177371) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @Yolo521-bot, @g62nkcx4q7-wq, and @vincentkoc.
  • Agent execution: Retry setup-dependent tools correctly, stop degenerate streamed arguments, reject invalid worktree names before creating subagents, and avoid false history-rewrite warnings for missing tool results. (#176306) (#177659) (#182184) (#178954) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @joshavant.
  • Update diagnostics: Avoid FIFO hangs, inspect the selected profile, retain run watching and database-restoration warnings, report wizard failures as JSON, and avoid irrelevant host-service checks for custom installations, and use a monotonic terminal-open deadline. (#179394) (#172294) (#184384) (#188015) (#190946) (#188879) (#177551) (#178126) (#170665) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Leon-SK668, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @Nickfost, and @SunnyShu0925.
  • Setup and compatibility: Keep skills enabled when binaries exist elsewhere, restore Bun-only installation compatibility, report third-party npm installs accurately, reject ambiguous approval targets, and preserve malformed Hermes source data rather than corrupting it.   • Configuration editing: Surface inaccessible configuration roots and unreadable hook metadata, explain nested DM allowlists and rejected key renames, preserve keyboard focus while settings save, and retain setup selections across rescans. (#174609) (#175316) (#182415) (#180950) (#178175) (#179275) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @sem00-ft, @etzelm, and @shakkernerd.
  • Chat interface: Support keyboard submission of selected answers, avoid duplicate configuration metadata and completed widgets, preserve file drafts, retain slash-command clicks during catalog refresh, and correct avatars and generated session titles. (#173836) (#173850) (#177886) (#175544) (#181735) (#168940) (#178770) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @HootRock, @DonnieFi, @shakkernerd, and @holgergruenhagen.
  • Channels and notifications: Retire expired Discord components, avoid ambiguous cached mentions, resolve non-Latin channel names correctly, forget removed Matrix credentials, retry temporary DKIM failures, and report channel rate limits accurately. (#173429) (#182327) (#188127) (#186140) (#190439) (#172931) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @masatohoshino, @wr-web, and @vincentkoc.
  • Scheduling: Preserve reminders that mention heartbeat polls, refuse unconfirmed self-removal, clear removed alert destinations and stale topics, and retain running sessions in the selected store. (#129650) (#167857) (#177681) (#168827) (#176745) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @DasX, @yetval, and @obviyus.
  • Mobile, browser and voice: Show progress for messages from other clients, prevent repeated-message Wear crashes, handle unusable browser relay secrets, close cancelled Talk relays, preserve Twilio greetings and silence recovery, explain iMessage Automation failures, and restore Telegram Codex detach/rebind. (#171590) (#172354) (#180305) (#183681) (#193137) (#186117) (#175379) Thanks @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @Solvely-Colin, @IWhatsskill, @Patrick-Erichsen, @SebTardif, @cestercian, @ullrichg13, @anmol0b, @RomneyDa, @Satoshi-Kusumoto, and @obviyus.
  • Media and resource recovery: Preserve oversized generated media and streamed caption limits, avoid replaying completed empty video generations, release evicted avatar bytes, retry local-model loading after credentials change, and recover QuickJS initialization. (#174601) (#174661) (#174737) (#173756) (#185112) (#177901) (#191952) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus and @vincentkoc.
  • Execution and authentication: Deliver result-first execution notices, activate local password SecretRefs, acquire worktree content before pack admission, keep ingress retries behind their age gate, fence late replies after completion, preserve native model readiness and host precedence, and recognize prepared native authentication for CLI model routes. Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @joshavant, and @obviyus.
  • Scheduled account continuity: Preserve account selection and delivery continuity for required scheduling repairs. Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @fuller-stack-dev, @Kimiyu-186, @VACInc, and @RomneyDa.

OpenClaw 2026.11.1

Highlights

  • Safer Mac settings: failed config saves no longer overwrite secrets, and turning off Tailscale exposure keeps Gateway authentication intact. (#187734, #187664) Fixes #187600, #187597 Thanks @anmol0b.
  • More reliable channel replies: Telegram, Discord, and webhook conversations keep reaching the agent after request handlers or earlier turns finish. (#179200, #179385, #179704, #189457) Fixes #178554 Thanks @LiuwqGit, @jalehman, and @vincentkoc.
  • Conversations survive more interruptions: oversized turns retain useful history, and stopping the first Claude CLI turn no longer starts the next message from scratch. (#191146, #181966, #186380) Fixes #191133, #181945 Thanks @Yun-0000, @obviyus, @mirasrael, and @holgergruenhagen.
  • Update recovery gets unstuck after crashed or canceled updaters, restores the Windows Gateway after failed verification, and avoids repeated full-database copying during large-state checks. (#177932, #186787, #189647, #182632, #187921) Fixes #177684, #184893, #189620 Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, @TheAngryPit, @sukhdeepjohar, @syxscott, and @stephen3303.
  • Subagents keep their follow-ups through model and session changes, while parent sessions receive child approvals even with a custom session store. (#186238, #183501, #189827) Fixes #179289, #189823 Thanks @Marvinthebored, @RomneyDa, and @ekinnee.
  • Android End Talk with a compatible Gateway stops listening without canceling accepted agent work, so its answer can still arrive in chat; explicit cancellation remains available. (#172276, #188798) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Provider recovery respects provider-specified rate-limit timing, and Gemini Flash text models use Interactions by default on the official API-key endpoint while custom proxies retain their existing default. (#180280, #189395) Thanks Ayaan Zaidi, @evomach, @sukhdeepjohar, @RomneyDa.

Changes

  • Claude CLI: saved subscription accounts can make configured models available without a separate native login, and operators can opt into native Agent and Workflow orchestration through plugins.entries.anthropic.config.managedNativeTools; the default remains off and restricted runs keep their existing tool limits. (#179203, #183765) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Anthropic: API-key setup can record an optional Anthropic workspace ID; existing workspace headers are preserved, and workspace-scoped keys need no extra setting. (#186976) Thanks Ayaan Zaidi, @evomach, @sukhdeepjohar, @RomneyDa.
  • Google: Interactions requests honor managed proxy and TLS settings, rotate eligible API keys before streaming after a rate limit, preserve native video input, and forward nucleus sampling consistently; choose google-generative-ai when explicit Gemini cache handles are required. (#189395, #190695) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Bedrock Mantle: discovered numbered OpenAI GPT models select the Responses route automatically, while GPT-OSS keeps Chat Completions and Claude keeps Anthropic Messages. Thanks @MertBasar0, @anmol0b, @shakkernerd, @kybrcore, @sukhdeepjohar, @potoior, @RomneyDa.
  • Control UI: the model picker shows the configured active context budget rather than only the model maximum, and short session links retain their intended navigation target. (#180870, #183148) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Google Chat: remote HTTP(S) attachments are delivered as visible links alongside captions; local files and native uploads remain unsupported with service-account authentication. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Update diagnostics: detailed readiness separates a ready core from channel outages, allowing repaired updaters to finish with named channel warnings without hiding HTTP 503 or weakening normal service-start checks. Thanks @duyufansh2008, @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Network and tool safety: ClickClack and ClawHub reject redirects into unrelated private services, Discord CDN downloads no longer inherit browser private-network access, and FIFO native-hook credentials are rejected without hanging the agent. (#190944, #190939, #191458, #191423) Thanks @pgondhi987, @SebTardif, and @Leon-SK668.
  • Doctor consent and access policy: noninteractive checks no longer download plugins without repair consent, and explicitly empty group allowlists remain empty instead of being repopulated. (#191523, #174787) Fixes #191420, #173826 Thanks @brandonulrich and @lockhartheavyindustries.
  • Recovery data: malformed UTF-8 legacy imports are rejected instead of replacing original content; failed skill restore rollbacks preserve the original copy, and cleanup refuses destructive work when workspace inspection fails. (#180861, #173954, #174195, #176362) Fixes #180782, #180795 Thanks @RomneyDa, @duyufansh2008, and @wangmiao0668000666.
  • Log redaction: malformed custom entries no longer disable valid rules or built-in secret protection; invalid policy is reported while safe redaction remains active. (#173471) Thanks @skyzhao1223 and @RomneyDa.
  • Secret egress: reject chains relying on the distrusted emSign ECC G3 root in the managed proxy and exported subprocess CA bundle; restart the Gateway after updating, and update clients with independent trust stores separately. (#179249) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • macOS connectivity: configured credentials take precedence over stale app environment, typed environment secret references resolve correctly, and remote Settings respects the Control UI base path. (#191468, #185141, #128175) Fixes #164596 Thanks @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, and @goldmar.
